title: Fix /users SQL query returning 500
description: The /users handler uses the invalid SQL keyword FORM instead of FROM, causing database query failures and HTTP 500 responses. Correct the query and verify the endpoint.
close_reason: Corrected FORM to FROM in the /users SQL query; syntax check passes.

title: Build eval harness: cases + SDK runner + judge rubric
description: eval/ dir: cases (trigger + protocol + retrospective-injected), runner via pi SDK createAgentSession with skillsOverride, deterministic regex checks + LLM-as-judge. Models: openrouter deepseek-v4-flash, glm-5.3-flash, sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-luna. Retrospective note: 0 profanity in 868 local sessions, so retros cases seed real session contexts with injected swears.

title: Restructure commands/ to prompts/ for pi package support
description:
commands/ is inert in pi. Rename to prompts/ (pi package convention dir), add package.json with pi manifest + pi-package keyword so Installing git:github.com/charly-vibes/fck...

title: README: distribution matrix + pi install section
description: Add what-works-where matrix (skills.sh / Claude Code / pi) and pi install instructions after restructure lands.

title: Fix path-based cross-references in prompts to name-based
description: prompts/*.md reference the protocol as a literal path 'skills/fck/SKILL.md' which never exists after install in any harness. Reference by name (the fck skill) with path as fallback hint.

title: Move SKILL.md design note to references/
description: Design note + version history at bottom of SKILL.md is contributor context, not runtime. Move to skills/fck/references/design.md for leaner progressive disclosure.
